claim.quote: We report on the extraction of the structure functions F_2 and Delta xF_3 = xF_3(nu)-xF_3(nubar) from CCFR nu_mu-Fe and nubar_mu-Fe differential cross sections.

date.note: arXiv v1 date; published Phys. Rev. Lett. 86, 2742 (2001).

key_value_text.quote: This first measurement of Delta xF_3, which is useful in testingmodels of heavy charm production, is higher than current theoretical predictions.
key_value_text.value: First measurement of Delta xF3 = xF3(nu) - xF3(nubar), higher than current theoretical predictions

name: Measurements of F_2 and xF_3(nu)-xF_3(nubar) from CCFR nu_mu-Fe and nubar_mu-Fe data in a physics model independent way

summary.plain: CCFR extracted the proton structure functions from its neutrino and antineutrino cross sections without relying on a model, resolving a long-standing discrepancy with muon-scattering data and making the first measurement of the difference in xF3 between neutrinos and antineutrinos.
summary.technical: Physics-model-independent extraction of F2 and Delta xF3 = xF3(nu) - xF3(nubar) from CCFR nu_mu-Fe and nubar_mu-Fe differential cross sections; F2 ratios agree within 5 % with NLO massive-charm predictions; Delta xF3 is higher than theory.

title: Measurements of F_2 and xF_3(nu)-xF_3(nubar) from CCFR nu_mu-Fe and nubar_mu-Fe data in a physics model independent way
why_it_matters: Resolved the neutrino-muon structure-function disagreement and tested heavy-charm production models.
